JourneyIQ Diagnostic

One clear decision brief from scattered operating signals.

A delayed batch. A conflicting ETA. Safety stock that looks fine until it is not. JourneyIQ joins the signals up for one operational question at a time.

What you find out

  • What is happening
  • Where the problem actually sits
  • What evidence supports the diagnosis
  • What to address first
Scattered signalsJourneyIQDecision brief

How it runs

  1. 01Agree the question

    For example: why do hospital customers see late deliveries when our OTIF is 90%?

  2. 02Gather the minimum evidence

    Usually three to five data sources, agreed in advance.

  3. 03Structure the signals

    Separate urgent risk from background noise, and show how they connect.

  4. 04Deliver the brief

    The material issues, their causes and the first three actions, each with an owner.

Every finding is reviewed by me, and every recommendation is yours to accept or reject.

Next step

Bring one operating question.

We will agree the evidence needed before anything is shared.
